items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Jim? Not Jim Robinson. Jim Little. Oh, oh yeah.

ctx.x: And who was in the band with Ben Coe?
With Ben Coe and D.D. They had Hollywood. Jim Robinson. You know the fella next door there? Jim? Jim Robinson? Yeah, right next- Jim? Not Jim Robinson. Jim Little. Oh, oh yeah.
